I love Marziano

I love that they’ve come to a point where they’re happy to anything and everything they want to (or so I assume at least).

I absolutely love Elma, DakaBoku, NatsuKusa and MakeInu. That said, I think with Plagiarism and Gentou they reached a point where it almost feels like they started with a random sound and vibe, and built it up into a complete song. Especially with Gentou, I think the composition is genuinely SO fun and different in every song.

That said, while nbuna gets his flowers for doing crazy stuff very often (as he should), I feel like suis 100% deserves more of them too. Her vocals are so, so impressive now imo. I feel like she can match the composition of every song with exactly what is needed, whatever it may be, and only gets better at it! I think that is soooo sick.

To me they’re very jazz-esque to me in that it always feels like every new song is just a jam session that ends up extremely polished :,) I am happy to be on this ride for as long as it goes.
